fields.Name: Stripe
fields.Description: Stripe payments — cards, wallets, hosted checkout.

fields.Name: Manual
fields.Description: Finance records the money movement by hand (check, wire, cash). Always available.

fields.Name: Stored Value
fields.Description: Money we already hold: a gift card (StoredValueAccount, a bearer instrument with a redeemable code) or an over-paid order's negative balance (account credit, D68). One driver, because the mechanics of spending them are identical even though their ownership, transferability, expiry and accounting treatment are not. No gateway — we are the institution, so there is no fee.

fields.Name: J.P. Morgan
fields.Description: PLACEHOLDER, deliberately INACTIVE. Which API is an open question — legacy Orbital/Paymentech versus the newer J.P. Morgan Payments API — and the answer changes the driver, not just its credentials. The row exists so the type is addressable and the capability flags are somewhere to correct; activating it before a driver is registered would make PaymentProviderResolver refuse, which is the correct behaviour and a confusing way to discover this.
